title: Explicit shifted quotient system and descended inclusion
statement: def formalShiftedQuotient {X : Scheme.{u}} (I : X.IdealSheafData) (S : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ X.Modules) (d : ℕ) : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ X.Modules The functor is defined explicitly from quotient reductions. Given a coherent formal module F and a natural transformation j : S to F.obj, formalShiftedQuotientι is the canonical descended map to F.obj with component equation formalShiftedQuotientι_comp.

proof.text: Construct the quotient objects and reduce the shifted transitions with formalModuleQuotientMap. Its identity and composition laws prove the functor laws.

For j : S to F.obj, multiplication by I^(n+1) followed by j_(n+d) and the transition to F_n factors through the zero ideal product of F_n. Cokernel descent constructs formalShiftedQuotientι. Cancel quotient projections and use naturality of j and the functor laws to prove naturality; cokernel.π_desc gives the component factorization equation.
